name: Flexi Fabric
description: A print-in-place sheet of interlocking links that drapes, folds and squishes like fabric, printed flat with no supports. Five link patterns (square links, chainmail rings, diamonds, hex scales, TriFlex-style triangles), five sheet outlines, eight colour modes over an eight-colour palette, optional two-tone links, and an SVG or PNG picture laid across the sheet either as link-sized pixels or as an exact inlay in the top layers.
source: inspired by MakerWorld "Flexi Fabric Fidget" (models/2550125) and "TriFlex - Super Flexible Fabric" by Rossero (MakerWorld 1958162; Printables 1460006, 7,908 downloads), with the mechanism studied from Printables "Fabric/Chainmail Fidget" by Molodos (1538278, 9,743 downloads) and Flowalistik's "Chainmail 2.0" (288, 3,622 downloads)
